decisions.reason: The source explicitly applies the reference-matched colour direction only to the Weave Print; the Zebra palette remains independently specified.
The Weave Print colour revision does not change the independently specified terracotta interior or black border.
Selecting a reference-matched palette for one print does not alter the existing CMYK, Pantone, ICC-profile, or supplier-calibration workflow.
The source changes only the Weave Print palette and does not modify the mustard block-colour pareo.
The Weave Print palette revision does not change the requirement to provide final production-ready artwork files.
